newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Aeroflot net profit 124.5 bln rbls in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Aeroflot net profit 124.5 bln rbls in 1996.

text.p: Aeroflot - Russian International Airlines posted a 124.5 billion rouble net profit in 1996 against losses of 530 billion roubles in 1995, according to the company's annual report.
The report said the company earned 7.5 trillion roubles revenues last year compared with 4.8 trillion in 1995.
Aeroflot's expenditures were 7.3 trillion roubles in 1996.
Valery Okulov, Aeroflot chief executive, told reporters on Tuesday that 1996 was a very successful year for the company.
"We have ended with net profit, while many others Russian airlines had big losses last year," Okulov said.
He said Aeroflot carried 3.8 million passengers and 90,000 tonnes of cargo and mail in 1996, which makes, respectively, 9.1 percent and 27.6 percent growth compared with 1995.
